overview.title: Overview
overview.empty: No cards yet. Add one on the Plugins page, or put plugin folders in {dir}; then restart hostdeck.
overview.hidden: Every card is hidden. Show one again from the plugins page, or reset the layout.
error.port_unavailable: Port {detail} belongs to this plugin, and another program is using it. The port stays with this plugin. Stop the other program, or remove this plugin and add it again.
service.clear.explain: Clears this service's cache and site data: HTTP cache, localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage and service workers. Cookies and other services are left alone. A service that keeps its sign-in in localStorage will sign you out of it. Its service worker is removed, so web push notifications that depend on it need subscribing again. Scripts and styles this tab has already loaded may still be used; if the service still looks out of date afterwards, reload the console page.
service.clear.unconfirmed: the service's port did not confirm it
error.command_timeout: The command did not finish in time
error.command_output: The command printed something hostdeck cannot read: {detail}
action.interrupted: The request was cut off. If the action restarts hostdeck itself, that is expected: reload the page in a few seconds.
error.not_offered: The plugin no longer offers this action on this item. The list is read again.
error.threshold: A threshold does not fit the value: {detail}
error.bad_manifest: This plugin's plugin.yaml has a problem: {detail}
error.env_missing: The environment variable {detail} is not set. Start hostdeck with it set.
catalog.title: Pages & plugins
catalog.intro: Manage your connected pages and plugins, or add something new.
error.already_added: There is already a plugin folder of that name.
error.not_installed: That plugin is no longer in the plugins folder. The list is read again.
error.name_taken: A folder with the name it would take is already there. Rename or remove one of them first.
error.reload_failed: The change was made, but reading the plugins folder again failed: {detail}. Restart hostdeck to use it.

error.not_local: Only pages on this machine or your local network can be embedded.
